question: How are the eye-mantra and weapon-mantra completed within the six-limb ritual procedure?
premises: The six-limb procedure precedes the body-placement.
inference: After giving the eye and weapon formulas, one should complete the six-limb rite and then perform the body-placement.
plain_english: The eye-mantra, beginning with agni, is: agnitejojvālāmaṇe huṃphaṭ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ. The weapon-mantra should be with all words: sarvatejovālāmaṇe huṃphaṭsvāhā astrāya phaṭ. Having thus performed the six-limb rite, one should perform the body-placement as follows.
